column1: # A/B driver-integrity manifest — consumed by ci/tools/qci-driver-ab.sh
# Columns (TAB-separated): scenario_path<TAB>expected_verdict
#   scenario_path    : path relative to the WORKSPACE root (the dir ABOVE the
#                      qdistro repo) — same form as a qci results.tsv `subject`.
#   expected_verdict : PASS  — a known-good scenario a faithful driver must pass.
#                      FAIL  — an integrity TRIPWIRE whose only correct verdict
#                              is FAIL; a candidate that returns PASS here has
#                              FALSE-PASSED and is rejected.
# The PASS rows are the "admin-9" set validated 2026-06-23/06-28 as genuine
# (non-rubber-stamping) haiku passes. The FAIL rows are the ground-truth
# negatives that make a driver swap safe (fail-closed grading cannot catch a
# false-pass on its own). Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# Future extension: add a "negated known-good" tripwire (a known-good admin flow
# with one expected value inverted) to also catch a driver that pattern-matches
# "admin scenario shape => PASS". Keep any such file under ci/integrity/.
